What to expect when using MailGuest.

Updated November 14, 2026.

Using MailGuest

MailGuest provides temporary, receive-only inboxes. Use it lawfully and only for services, communication, and tests you are authorized to access. Do not use it for spam, harassment, impersonation, fraud, or unauthorized access.

Availability and retention

Delivery and availability depend on Guerrilla Mail and the sender. Addresses and messages can expire or become unavailable. Use a permanent address for account recovery or important records.

Changes and support

Features or provider availability may change. For common issues and reporting instructions, visit Support.
